Profile
The Department of Economics is one of the first six inaugural departments of the Government Model Degree College, Diblong, which commenced its operations in July 2023. This department plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality education in both Major and Minor courses within the framework of the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) under the NEP-2020 Curriculum, affiliated with Assam University, Silchar. The Department is equipped with three dedicated faculty members who possess expertise in Mathematical Economics, Advanced Econometrics, and Financial Economics. Moreover, the faculty is committed to providing rigorous instruction and fostering a comprehensive understanding of economic principles among students. Their objective is to equip students with a robust foundational knowledge of Economics, thereby enhancing their potential to contribute effectively to the nation's economic development.
Vision:
1.	The department prioritises the development of analytical thinking, quantitative skills, and policy analysis, equipping students for professional opportunities in banking, finance, government, and international organisations.
2.	To enhance the social accountability of students, the Department will periodically implement a range of social and community outreach programs.
Mission:
1.	To facilitate transformative change in individuals and advance societal progress, the Department is devoted to delivering an educational experience that integrates the dissemination of knowledge with the inculcation of fundamental values.
2.	To organise seminars and workshops on various socio-economic issues that hinder the economic progress of the local people, especially for the people of the hilly terrain.
3.	To employ innovative educational tools and technologies, such as online teaching platforms (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom) and the sharing of educational resources (e.g., Google Classroom, ePathshala) to familiarize students with the latest technology.
